text.arabic_uthmani: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن كَانَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ كَفَرْتُم بِهِۦ مَنْ أَضَلُّ مِمَّنْ هُوَ فِى شِقَاقٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ

words.gloss_range: commanded saying as authorized proclamation that governs the following challenge
words.root_gloss_range: speech, saying, declaring, answering, and articulated positions; local imperative narrows the field to commissioned declaration
words.prose: The opening {{ar:قُلْ}} ({{tr:qul}}) makes the whole ayah a commissioned speech act. The messenger is installed as the speaker, and the following challenge is governed as authorized argument rather than private debate. Its speech-root range becomes formal proclamation, while recurrence with the same source-risk opening at 46:10 and a local contrast with 41:6 make the command part of a recognized challenge pattern. The one-syllable imperative, with its hard qaf onset and quick release, helps the direct confrontation arrive abruptly.

topics.headline: imperative governs the whole challenge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the entire challenge is commissioned speech, not narrator-only discourse.
topics.reason: The imperative is syntactically attached to the full quoted challenge and carries a 2MS commissioned speaker.

topics.headline: speech as formal declaration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that saying here functions as an accountable declaration placed into evidence.
topics.reason: The root range is narrowed by imperative mood and the forensic challenge frame into formal proclamation.

topics.headline: source-risk formula with 46:10
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command belongs to a repeated source-testing pattern, especially the parallel opening at 46:10 and the local doctrinal frame at 41:6.
topics.reason: The supplied parallels support a formulaic command-and-consideration frame without making them control the local parse.

topics.headline: abrupt imperative sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the brief imperative as an audible snap before the longer challenge unfolds.
topics.reason: The row ties sound texture to the command launch and does not conflict with grammar.

words.gloss_range: formulaic have-you-considered challenge selecting evaluative judgment rather than physical sight
words.root_gloss_range: seeing, perceiving, knowing, and judging; the local challenge formula selects considered evaluation
words.prose: {{ar:أَرَءَيْتُمْ}} ({{tr:a-raʾaytum}}) is perfect in form but works as an immediate demand for judgment. The sight-root range is narrowed into considered evaluation: the hearers are asked to inspect the risk of rejection if the source is divine. The same source-test opening at 46:10, the local movement from 41:51 into direct address, and the seeing-root return at 41:53 make this word a hinge between diagnosis and demanded perception. The qiraat and hamza rows keep the summons acoustically specific: variants may ease, lengthen, or streamline the delivery, while the clustered hamzas can slow the challenge with glottal catches without changing the addressees or the sense.

topics.headline: consideration formula demands judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word asks for an immediate verdict, not a memory of literal sight.
topics.reason: Formulaic usage and fronted interrogative force select deliberative evaluation under the conditional case.

topics.headline: source-test frame with 46:10
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the question as part of a recognized source-risk pattern at 46:10 and a local seeing thread that continues at 41:53.
topics.reason: The parallel rows give concrete formula and local recurrence evidence while leaving the local conditional challenge primary.

topics.headline: hamza and variant pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the demanded judgment is also heard as a pressure point in recitation.
topics.reason: The qiraat and sound rows affect pacing and acoustic force, not the grammatical address.

topics.headline: 41:51 portrait becomes direct address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the move from the human portrait in 41:51 into direct evaluative cross-examination in 41:52.
topics.reason: Boundary rows coherently describe the discourse shift into second-person challenge.

words.gloss_range: conditional possibility that makes divine provenance and rejection testable without asserting the premise outright
words.prose: {{ar:إِن}} ({{tr:in}}) opens the risk chamber of the ayah. It does not assert the premise as already granted; it holds possible divine provenance open and makes rejection under that possibility the test. Because the conditional particle comes after the challenge formula, uncertainty itself becomes the ground of accountability.

topics.headline: conditional risk frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the argument works by risk-testing a possibility rather than by first forcing an assertion.
topics.reason: The conditional particle scopes over the source premise and rejection sequence before the rhetorical verdict.

words.gloss_range: conditional being as provenance-state for an unnamed matter, not bare existence
words.root_gloss_range: being, becoming, occurring, and established state; local predicate narrows it to source-status
words.prose: {{ar:كَانَ}} ({{tr:kāna}}) makes the unnamed matter a completed source-status scenario inside the condition. The hidden subject keeps the disputed object compressed until the later pronoun resumes it, while the predicate assigns provenance rather than mere existence. The same source-testing frame at 46:10 confirms the formulaic pattern, but locally the verb is the hinge that lets provenance precede rejection.

topics.headline: hidden matter receives source status
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices one unnamed matter being carried from possible source to later rejection.
topics.reason: The 3MS hidden subject and later pronoun continuity preserve one compressed object through the condition.

topics.headline: being as provenance, not bare existence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the condition is about source-status, not simply whether something exists.
topics.reason: The local prepositional predicate selects a state of provenance while perfect aspect packages it as the tested scenario.

topics.headline: conditional hinge of the ayah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the verb as the pivot between the challenge opening and the provenance phrase.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the following source phrase the predicate of this conditional verb.

topics.headline: source formula with 46:10
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the conditional source test belongs to a recurrent formula, especially 46:10.
topics.reason: The recurrence rows support formulaic recognition while local grammar still determines the predicate relation.

words.gloss_range: source-from relation introducing provenance rather than partition
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) makes the predicate a source phrase. It marks provenance from the divine presence rather than partition from a larger whole, so origin is established before the ayah names rejection. Even the small unfused particle leaves the source relation visible, and its nasal contact with the following presence noun makes that link audible.

topics.headline: source-from provenance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the condition tests origin-from-source, not a partitive relation.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the locative noun in the predicate of the conditional verb and is locally source-marking.

words.gloss_range: source-locative presence with authority, governed by source-from and completed by the divine possessor
words.root_gloss_range: nearness, presence, possession, and being at/with; local construct narrows it to provenance from an authority-domain
words.prose: {{ar:عِندِ}} ({{tr:ʿindi}}) gives the source phrase a presence-and-authority shape. It is governed by the source preposition and itself governs the divine name, so provenance is staged as from the domain of divine possession. That source-side authority also contrasts with the later opposition field. The repeated phrase with the same source-test opening at 46:10 makes this provenance wording formulaic, while the local grammar keeps it as the predicate content of the condition.

topics.headline: locative construct source chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that source is built through a visible chain: from, presence, and divine possessor.
topics.reason: The local attachments make this word both governed by the source preposition and completed by the divine name.

topics.headline: presence as authority-domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices provenance as nearness to an authority-domain rather than bare origin.
topics.reason: The locative noun and construct relation narrow the root range into authoritative source-presence.

topics.headline: provenance phrase with 46:10
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the wording as a marked provenance formula, especially through the identical phrase in 46:10.
topics.reason: The supplied recurrence and pairing evidence support formulaic salience without replacing the local source predicate.

words.gloss_range: specific divine proper name as the possessor/source of the tested message
words.root_gloss_range: deity, worship-authority, and the proper divine name; local grammar selects the specific proper name in a genitive source phrase
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:allāhi}}) completes the source phrase with the specific divine proper name. The genitive position fixes the tested provenance as from God, not from an undefined deity, and it stands just before the pivot to rejection. The worship-authority field remains relevant as pressure, and the derivational dispute leaves bewilderment as a background resonance, while the proper-name form keeps the local sense specific. The recurrence with the source-and-denial frame at 46:10 reinforces the risk of denying what may be from this source.

topics.headline: specific divine source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the source is fixed by the proper divine name, not left generic.
topics.reason: The divine proper name fills the genitive possessor slot in the source phrase.

topics.headline: worship-authority field under a proper name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices worship-authority pressure around the source, while the local form remains the proper divine name.
topics.reason: The root-family and etymological rows are preserved as pressure, but local grammar and form select the proper name.

topics.headline: divine name before the pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the divine source phrase closing immediately before the turn to rejection of the same hidden matter.
topics.reason: The local sequence places the divine name at the boundary before the rejection clause and the later pronoun resumes the same object.

topics.headline: source-and-denial pattern with 46:10
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine-source language and denial recur together in a recognized challenge field, including 46:10.
topics.reason: The recurrence rows support the contrastive configuration of divine source and disbelief.

topics.headline: source dependency made audible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the source phrase as a joined recitational unit.
topics.reason: The sound rows describe liaison and completion of the source phrase without changing the syntax.

words.gloss_range: sequential and rank-escalating pivot from possible divine source to rejection
words.prose: {{ar:ثُمَّ}} ({{tr:thumma}}) is the ayah’s pivot from possible divine source to rejection. It keeps the two beats connected but not identical: provenance is completed first, then disbelief is introduced as a later and weightier response. Its geminated sound thickens the turn at exactly the point where the argument escalates.

topics.headline: pivot from source to rejection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that rejection comes after a completed source condition and is made more severe by the pivot.
topics.reason: The conjunction joins the rejection verb to the conditional source scenario while marking sequence and escalation.

topics.headline: thickened pivot sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the turn to rejection as audible weight, not just logical sequence.
topics.reason: The gemination row coherently supports acoustic emphasis at the pivot.

words.gloss_range: second-person plural completed rejection or denial of the source-tested matter
words.root_gloss_range: covering, concealing, denying, and disbelieving; local verb with its complement selects culpable rejection
words.prose: {{ar:كَفَرْتُم}} ({{tr:kafartum}}) names the addressees’ completed rejection after the source-risk premise. The second-person plural suffix makes the accusation communal and direct, and the attached complement targets the same hidden matter already tested for provenance. The covering image remains as moral pressure: denial is felt as covering over possible source evidence. The contrast with 46:10 is sharper because that parallel uses a simple wa-link where this ayah uses a heavier later-then pivot, and the local return from 41:50 keeps rejection inside a recurring challenge pattern that links divine authority to misguidance. The hard stop and fricative texture make the rejection verb acoustically forceful.

topics.headline: completed plural rejection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices rejection as a completed second-person plural stance after the source premise.
topics.reason: The verb is joined after the pivot and carries 2MP agreement, making the audience directly responsible.

topics.headline: denial takes the hidden object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rejection is aimed at the same source-tested matter, not left objectless.
topics.reason: The prepositional complement supplies the object-domain for the rejection verb.

topics.headline: covering image in denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices denial as morally charged covering over a possible divine source, while the local verb still means reject or disbelieve.
topics.reason: The root image is coherent as pressure, but local syntax selects the rejection sense with its complement.

topics.headline: rejection contrasts with 46:10 and 41:50
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the local rejection as part of a recurring source-risk challenge, especially contrasted with 46:10 and linked back to 41:50.
topics.reason: The recurrence rows support a contrastive pattern around disbelief, divine authority, and direct address.

topics.headline: hard sound of rejection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the rejection verb as semantically and acoustically forceful.
topics.reason: The sound row is tied to the verb and the convergence row combines form, image, and parallel evidence.

words.gloss_range: compact preposition plus pronoun resuming the unnamed matter as the target of rejection
words.prose: {{ar:بِهِۦ}} ({{tr:bihi}}) keeps the unnamed object continuous. The pronoun points back to the matter whose possible divine source was just tested, and the preposition makes it the target-domain of rejection. Because the object stays compact and pronominal, the ayah links source and denial without having to rename the message.

topics.headline: hidden object resumed by pronoun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices one unnamed matter carried from source-risk into the rejection beat.
topics.reason: The pronoun is strongly licensed as resuming the same message or matter tested in the condition.

topics.headline: preposition plus pronoun marks rejection target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the rejection target as compactly attached rather than independently restated.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the pronoun as the complement of the rejection verb.

words.gloss_range: rhetorical who/whosoever subject that opens the comparative verdict
words.prose: {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}) turns the apodosis into a rhetorical ranking question. It asks who, or what kind of person, could be more astray under the stated condition. The open person-class lets the addressed group see itself as a type rather than as a merely named party.

topics.headline: who as subject of the verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the answer to the condition arriving as a censure question.
topics.reason: The interrogative pronoun functions as the subject of the elative predicate in the apodosis.

topics.headline: open person-class from 41:51 into verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verdict targets a representative type, carrying the human portrait of 41:51 into public ranking.
topics.reason: The rows describe an open person-class and a boundary shift from human description into ranking verdict.

words.gloss_range: elative misguidance: more astray, ranked through a comparison benchmark and spatially colored by lostness
words.root_gloss_range: straying, losing the way, error, and misguidance; local elative ranks the condition as worse misdirection
words.prose: {{ar:أَضَلُّ}} ({{tr:aḍallu}}) ranks the person under the condition as more astray. The elative form requires a comparison benchmark and turns the question into censure rather than neutral inquiry. Its root image keeps error spatial: lostness is a wrong direction that the final distance word will complete. The far-error echo with 4:116 and the local link to 41:48 make misguidance and remoteness converge. The heavy ḍ sound and doubled lām also thicken the verdict word at the point of censure.

topics.headline: elative censure predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the question is a ranked verdict, not a simple description of error.
topics.reason: The elative predicate is attached to the interrogative subject and points forward to the comparison standard.

topics.headline: misguidance as lost direction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that error is mapped as wrong direction moving toward the final image of distance.
topics.reason: The root field supports directional lostness, and the local final adjective completes that spatial pressure.

topics.headline: far-error echoes with 4:116 and 41:48
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this local elative enters a far-error field, including distant misguidance at 4:116 and the local return from 41:48.
topics.reason: The supplied parallels tie misguidance to distance while the local wording distributes the field across the elative and closing adjective.

topics.headline: heavy sound of misguidance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the misguidance word as acoustically heavy at the verdict point.
topics.reason: The sound row is local to the word and adds a small but coherent auditory payoff.

words.gloss_range: contracted from-whom/than-whom benchmark phrase for the elative comparison
words.prose: {{ar:مِمَّنْ}} ({{tr:mimman}}) supplies the benchmark after the elative. Its contraction fuses comparison and personhood, so the verdict moves toward a concrete figure before the final diagnosis is spoken. The benchmark phrase also delays that diagnosis, and its nasal repetition binds comparison to personhood as the closing state approaches.

topics.headline: contracted comparison benchmark
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the comparison standard as both than-whom and from-whom compressed into one benchmark.
topics.reason: The contracted preposition-plus-pronoun supplies the standard required by the elative predicate.

topics.headline: benchmark delays final diagnosis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final diagnosis being held back until the benchmark person is prepared.
topics.reason: The phrase precedes the relative clause, and the sound row reinforces its person-focused comparison.

words.gloss_range: independent pronoun making the benchmark person explicit before the final state predicate
words.prose: {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) gives the benchmark an explicit grammatical center. Instead of letting the final state float as an abstract label, the independent pronoun makes a concrete representative person stand before the predicate. The nominal clause then identifies that person as lodged in the final state, and the singular form condenses the plural audience into a type.

topics.headline: explicit benchmark person
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final diagnosis is attached to a visible representative person.
topics.reason: The independent pronoun creates an overt subject position before the final predicate.

topics.headline: nominal clause as standing identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices opposition as a located condition of identity, not merely an action performed.
topics.reason: The pronoun functions as the nominal subject whose predicate is the following locative phrase.

words.gloss_range: locative within/in that turns schism into an enclosing state
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) spatializes the ending. With the abstract noun that follows, it turns opposition into a sphere the person inhabits rather than a one-time act or loose attribute. This preposition gives the final clause its diagnostic frame: misguidance becomes a location inside remote schism.

topics.headline: opposition as inhabited domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices schism as an enclosing state in which the person is placed.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the abstract noun as the predicate phrase of the explicit pronoun.

words.gloss_range: indefinite verbal noun of schism or hostile breach, inhabited after within and widened by distance
words.root_gloss_range: splitting, cleaving, opposing across sides, breach, schism, and hardship; local noun selects hostile breach while retaining the split image
words.prose: {{ar:شِقَاقٍۭ}} ({{tr:shiqāqin}}) is the breach at the heart of the final diagnosis. As an indefinite verbal noun after the locative preposition, it makes opposition an inhabited condition rather than a finite act, and its indefiniteness keeps the state open-ended. The root’s split image narrows into hostile schism while still making opposition feel like a cleft widened by the following adjective. The exact far-schism phrase appears at 22:53, and the limited root distribution plus constrained pairing with distance make 41:52 apply a marked formula to denial of possible divine provenance. The paired indefinite ending binds the breach noun to its distance adjective.

topics.headline: indefinite verbal noun state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices opposition as an open-ended condition one inhabits, not merely an act one performs.
topics.reason: The gerund is governed after the locative preposition and forms the core of the final nominal predicate.

topics.headline: split image widened by distance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the schism as a physical-like breach that the following adjective stretches into remoteness.
topics.reason: The root image supports splitting and opposition, while adjective agreement locks distance onto the breach noun.

topics.headline: far-schism phrase at 22:53
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final diagnosis as a marked far-schism formula also attested at 22:53, not as an ordinary disagreement term.
topics.reason: The supplied exact phrase and distribution rows support formulaic salience while preserving the current source-denial context.

topics.headline: paired indefinite cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the noun and adjective bound together by the repeated indefinite ending.
topics.reason: The cadence row is tied to the local noun-adjective pair and supports their unity.

words.gloss_range: indefinite qualitative remoteness grading the schism itself and closing the verdict
words.root_gloss_range: distance, remoteness, separation, and hard-to-reachness; local adjective makes the breach qualitatively remote
words.prose: {{ar:بَعِيدٍۢ}} ({{tr:baʿīdin}}) closes the ayah by making distance the quality of the schism itself. Agreement binds it to the breach noun, and indefiniteness leaves the remoteness qualitative rather than measured. Its root field turns the verdict into moral and relational separation, answering the earlier elative by letting misguidance end as remote schism. Echoes with distant misguidance at 4:116 and the far-schism phrase at 22:53 converge in the final word, while the paired genitive indefinite endings and final nasal closure let the remoteness linger.

topics.headline: distance qualifies the schism
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices distance as an attribute of the schism itself, not an independent afterthought.
topics.reason: Agreement and qualitative adjective form bind the word to the preceding breach noun.

topics.headline: remoteness as moral severity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices wrong direction becoming severe relational distance at the final word.
topics.reason: The root field supports remoteness and separation, and local closure ties it back to the elative of misguidance.

topics.headline: far-error fields at 4:116 and 22:53
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final word gathering distant-misguidance language from 4:116 and far-schism language from 22:53.
topics.reason: The supplied parallels connect the distance adjective with both misguidance and schism fields.

topics.headline: lingering final cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices remoteness as the final semantic and acoustic residue of the ayah.
topics.reason: The cadence rows tie the final indefinite ending to the ayah closure and distance image.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن كَانَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ كَفَرْتُم بِهِۦ
baseline_models.mechanism: The spoken prompt makes the hearers inspect a live provenance condition: possible occurrence from divine presence is set before their act of denying it. The construction diagnoses the risk in rejection without requiring the conditional itself to assert its premise.

activation_trace.role: The command externalizes the provenance test as an utterance addressed to the rejecters.
The alerting and interrogative force of أرأيتم demands considered disclosure, not bare eyesight.
Occurrence or presence supplies the live condition under which the response is tested.
Proximity and presence make the proposed source immediate rather than merely remote attribution.
Denial and obstruction of truth name the response whose consequence the question exposes.

changed_reading.before: A command simply to assert divine origin and condemn disbelief.
changed_reading.after: A command to test the hearers' position under the still-live possibility of divine origin, making premature rejection itself the object of judgment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ... فِى شِقَاقٍ بَعِيدٍ
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah maps a spatial reversal. Something posited as coming from nearness to God is met by covering, and the respondent is finally located on an opposite side whose separation extends far. Rejection is the pivot between source-nearness and receiver-distance.

activation_trace.role: Nearness and presence establish the source-side of the spatial contrast.
Covering supplies the intervening act that blocks relation to the near source.
The opposed half or side gives the final condition a concrete bilateral geometry.
Communal fracture and opposition turn that geometry into an adversarial relation.
Spatial and معنوي remoteness extend the split away from its source.
Distance pursued within hostility sharpens بعيد from neutral remoteness into sustained opposition.

changed_reading.before: The rejecter merely holds a doctrinal disagreement far from the truth.
changed_reading.after: The sentence places the rejecter on the far opposite side of something proposed as arriving from divine nearness, so distance is a produced relation rather than a static label.

baseline_models.mechanism: The material image of covering meets the hiddenness and loss branches of ضلال. The comparative can therefore describe a reflexive process: suppressing the available object makes it disappear from the suppressor's own field of guidance.

activation_trace.role: Covering and occlusion provide the initiating material action.
Disappearance into hiddenness renders what was covered unavailable to the coverer.
Loss of the object or route converts occlusion into practical disorientation.
Seeing by eye or insight is the capacity against which covering and hiddenness operate.

changed_reading.before: Disbelief and error are two adjacent moral predicates.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated descent, textual joining, detailed articulation, arrival, and denial turn the focus conditional into a compressed provenance-risk test. The possibility in 41:52 gathers a delivery chain already distributed across the surah without ceasing to be grammatically conditional.

activation_trace.role: The focus phrase anchors the model in proposed origin from divine presence.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated descent, a detailed written object, arrival, and denial; I infer that these specify the likely referent and evidential history of به, while the live alternative is that 41:52 leaves the antecedent deliberately unfilled and purely hypothetical.

changed_reading.before: The ayah poses an unsupported hypothetical about an unspecified thing being from God.
changed_reading.after: The ayah compresses an already traced delivery and denial sequence into a personal risk question: what if the articulated thing that reached you really has the source repeatedly claimed for it?

context_deltas.mechanism: Inner coverings, weighted ears, and an interposed barrier become the mechanics of the distant call. The focus phrase شقاق بعيد names the endpoint of a communication geometry constructed by the recipients themselves.

activation_trace.role: Opposition and group fracture anchor the communication break in the focus ayah.

structural_cues: 41:5 and 41:44 both pair ear burden with separation from the message.
The repeated بعيد moves from the location of a call in 41:44 to the state of schism in 41:52.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies coverings, ear-weight, a barrier, and a call experienced from afar; I infer a directional arrow from sustained blocking to communicative distance, while a live alternative is that the images independently describe an already existing refusal.

changed_reading.before: Far schism is an abstract theological distance imposed as a verdict.
changed_reading.after: Far schism is the accumulated communications state made by enclosing the heart, weighting hearing, and maintaining a barrier until even a nearby call is experienced as remote.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guidance is supplied, blindness is preferred, hearing is prohibited, and mixed noise is deliberately produced. These cues revise أضل from uninformed wandering into chosen anti-reception that actively degrades the conditions of finding a route.

activation_trace.role: Departure from guidance and purpose anchors the revised sense of comparative disorientation.

Heart-held preference supplies volition in selecting the contrary condition.

structural_cues: 41:17 grammatically places blindness as the selected object over guidance.
41:26 changes non-hearing from a condition into an imperative and a tactic for prevailing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a preference construction and an organized listening blockade; I infer that these make the focus comparative culpably agential, while the alternative is that أضل remains a result-state without specifying how responsibility is distributed.

changed_reading.before: The most astray person simply lacks correct information or direction.
changed_reading.after: The comparative marks the one who receives direction yet chooses blindness and then organizes the sensory conditions that keep direction from being heard.

context_deltas.mechanism: The covering branch of كفر is tested against attempted concealment that fails: hearing, sight, and skin testify, mistaken supposition causes ruin, and deviators are explicitly not hidden. The focus prompt asks the coverer to see a strategy whose result is exposure rather than secrecy.

activation_trace.role: Covering anchors the attempted concealment mechanism in the focus verb.
The interrogative alert turns the failed concealment back into an object of self-inspection.
Literal covering and concealment supply the attempted protective strategy.
Presence with witnessed disclosure makes the supposedly covered acts testify against their agents.
Unreliable supposition identifies the epistemic mistake sustaining concealment.
The source negates hiddenness, closing off the coverer's hoped-for result.
Seeing at the close of the ayah supplies the observing counterforce to concealment.

structural_cues: 41:22 negates successful self-covering before listing bodily witnesses.
41:40 directly negates the hiddenness of those who incline within the signs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, testimony, false supposition, negated hiddenness, and sight; I infer that the literal covering image of كفر participates in the same failed strategy, while the alternative is to keep كفر solely in its conventional denial branch.

changed_reading.before: كفرتم records a denial that can remain inward or hidden.
changed_reading.after: كفرتم becomes attempted occlusion that paradoxically stores up witnesses and exposes the coverer, so أرأيتم demands recognition of concealment's failure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Those who rejected earlier ask to be shown the two who misled them and seek to place those agents below. The focus ayah reuses seeing and misguidance but redirects the diagnostic toward the present second-person rejecters, interrupting the transfer of all agency to external misleaders.

activation_trace.role: The alerting question addresses the current agents and asks for their own judgment.
The comparative departure from guidance is now predicated within the hearers' own scenario.
A request to be shown external misleaders establishes the earlier direction of visual attribution.
Causative misguidance locates blame in two named external agents.
Deliberate placement turns attribution into an intended rearrangement of rank.
Low status supplies the punitive destination assigned to the blamed agents.

structural_cues: 41:29 and 41:52 pair the same seeing and misguidance roots in reversed address situations.
The request أَرِنَا targets others, whereas أَرَءَيْتُمْ makes the current hearers perform the diagnostic.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an earlier request to display external misleaders and a later second-person question about extreme misguidance; I infer a redirection of responsibility, while the live alternative is that 41:52 continues to describe an unnamed third party rather than the addressed rejecters.

changed_reading.before: The question only identifies some maximally misguided other person.
changed_reading.after: The question returns the seeing-and-blame operation to those who had externalized misguidance, forcing them to consider whether their own rejection occupies the comparative extreme.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two sequences pivot on God and then diverge: saying our Lord is God is followed by standing straight, whereas possible origin from God is followed by covering and far schism. The shared ثم marks opposed trajectories of response rather than incidental chronology.

activation_trace.role: The divine name fixes the source-point from which the focus trajectory turns.
Denial is the post-ثم action on the diverging trajectory.
Fracture is the relational endpoint of that response.
Spoken confession functions as an adopted conviction and initiates the contrasting sequence.
The same divine name supplies the common pivot in the earlier sequence.
Straightness and balanced uprightness provide the opposed post-ثم course.

structural_cues: 41:30 has قَالُوا رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَقَامُوا, while 41:52 has مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ كَفَرْتُم.
Both sequences move from relation to God through ثم into a durable human posture.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated divine name, ثم, and opposite response vocabularies; I infer a deliberate trajectory contrast, while the alternative is that the shared sequencing is local phrasing without an inter-ayah opposition.

changed_reading.before: ثم merely advances the hypothetical from divine origin to a later act of disbelief.
changed_reading.after: ثم marks a fork already modeled in the surah: relation to God can continue as upright alignment or turn through covering into widening fracture.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah gives an inverse operation for relational distance: repelling with what is better transforms enmity across the interval into immediate alliance and intimate nearness. This makes far schism a live relational configuration with a described counter-mechanism, not an ontologically fixed separation.

activation_trace.role: Adversarial fracture anchors the relation that the earlier mechanism can invert.
Distance carried far in hostility names the unrepaired endpoint.
Pushing away harm with a better act supplies the active reversal mechanism.
The interval between parties is the gap whose relational quality changes.
Explicit enmity supplies the initial state corresponding to schism.
Nearness without a separating interval supplies the transformed relation.
Intimate kin-like closeness intensifies the collapse of distance.

structural_cues: 41:34 explicitly changes the relation between two parties from عداوة to ولي حميم.
41:52 combines opposition with distance, preserving the same social-spatial dimensions in negative form.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit enemy-to-intimate transformation and a later far-schism state; I infer that the former is an inverse model for the latter, while the alternative is to keep 41:34 interpersonal and 41:52 solely epistemic.

changed_reading.before: Far schism is a settled category with no mechanism or inverse in view.
changed_reading.after: Far schism is the unrepaired form of a relation whose distance can, elsewhere in the same discourse, be actively collapsed by a better counter-response.

context_deltas.mechanism: Visible signs precede the focus question and promised showing follows it. Seeing humbled earth move into life, then being shown signs across horizons and selves until truth becomes clear, makes أرأيتم a hinge between available observation and continuing disclosure.

activation_trace.role: The focus alert asks hearers to report what follows from considered seeing.

Direct perception of the earth supplies an already available act of seeing.
The earth's life-like movement turns the sign into an observable transition.
Caused showing extends the focus demand into a future disclosure process.
Marks distributed through horizons and selves provide the objects to be shown.
Emergence into clarity supplies the stated endpoint of showing.
Stable correspondence with reality names what the signs are to clarify.
Knowledgeable testimony closes the evidentiary sequence.

structural_cues: 41:39 uses ترى before the focus, 41:52 uses أرأيتم, and 41:53 uses سنريهم.
The sequence progresses from a seen sign, through a diagnostic question, to signs shown until clarification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a three-stage seeing sequence around the focus; I infer that 41:52 functions as its epistemic hinge, while the alternative is that 41:53 begins a new promise rather than extending the focus challenge.

changed_reading.before: أرأيتم introduces an unanswerable rhetorical hypothetical detached from evidence.
changed_reading.after: أرأيتم occupies the threshold between signs already observable and signs still to be shown, asking for a provisional judgment that later clarification can test.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequence moves from a self-assured claim of good at God, through physically taking one's side far away, to a challenge about something from God's presence and a far opposite side. Bodily withdrawal exposes the instability of claimed nearness and supplies the motion that becomes شقاق بعيد.

activation_trace.role: Provenance from divine presence supplies the genuine-nearness pole.
The opposite side names the posture produced by lateral withdrawal.
Remoteness states the completed extent of that posture.
Nearness and standing are appropriated in the speaker's confident claim of reserved good.
Taking one's side away supplies an enacted movement of distancing.
The bodily side makes the withdrawal spatially concrete.
Estrangement and self-removal convert the bodily gesture into relational separation.

structural_cues: 41:50 claims لِى عِندَهُ لَلْحُسْنَى, 41:51 says نَـَٔا بِجَانِبِهِ, and 41:52 contrasts مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ with شِقَاقٍ بَعِيدٍ.
The three consecutive ayat move from claimed proximity, through sideward withdrawal, to explicit far-sidedness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the adjacent claim, gesture, and spatial verdict; I infer that the sequence tests professed nearness against enacted withdrawal, while the alternative is that 41:50 and 41:51 are parallel human types rather than stages in one trajectory.

changed_reading.before: The focus ayah abruptly labels rejection as remote schism.
changed_reading.after: The label completes a visible movement: self-awarded standing near God is contradicted by taking one's own side away until that posture hardens into a far opposite side.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the fruit-cover branch inside the focus root كفر through the immediately preceding image of fruit leaving its coverings. It remains anchored in كفرتم and in packet-backed خروج, ثمر, and أكمام branches, but downstream prose should present it only as a material counterimage, not as the lexical equivalence or primary sense of كفرتم.

activation_trace.role: The focus inventory's fruit-cover image lets covering be imagined as a sheath that withholds emergence.
Emergence from hiddenness supplies motion outward from enclosure.
Ripened fruit supplies the object ready to emerge.
The plant's sheath is the explicit neighboring material covering from which fruit comes out.

changed_reading.before: كفرتم is considered only as propositional denial.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, rejection acts like keeping a ripened disclosure shut in its sheath precisely where the surrounding sequence depicts signs and fruit emerging from coverings.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant ن ش ق mapping for شقاق and connects its snare to later doubt and encompassing knowledge. It remains anchored in the focus word شقاق and every added image is packet-resolvable, but downstream prose should label it an exploratory topology of entrapment rather than an etymology of شقاق.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant mapped branch recasts being in schism as being caught in a loop from which release is difficult.
Interpenetrating alternatives without settled certainty supply the loop's cognitive motion.
Persistent doubt and hesitation keep the subject oscillating within the split.
Complete encompassing knowledge supplies the larger field within which attempted remoteness cannot actually escape.

changed_reading.before: Far schism suggests free-standing distance outside the opposed object.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the schism is a self-tightening snare of unresolved alternatives: subjectively far away, yet still enclosed within what fully encompasses and knows it.

strongest_changes: The source conditional becomes a compressed test of rejecting a repeatedly delivered and articulated object.
Far schism becomes a manufactured communication distance built from coverings, ear-weight, barriers, and deliberate noise.
The shared ثم sets upright alignment and covering fracture on opposed post-divine trajectories.
The immediate sequence converts claimed nearness into bodily sideward withdrawal and finally far-sidedness.
أرأيتم becomes the hinge between signs already seen and signs promised to be shown until clarity.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly converted abstract predicates in 41:52 into mechanisms: source became delivery, disbelief became covering and failed concealment, misguidance became chosen anti-reception, and distant schism became a spatial, auditory, bodily, and potentially reversible relation.
remaining_uncertainties: The arrows from covering to hiddenness and from reception barriers to distance are reader-supplied causal inferences rather than explicit grammatical statements.
The contrast between the two ثم sequences is structurally strong but could be coincidental rather than an intended cross-ayah parallel.
The fruit-sheath and snare readings depend on branch-distant material images and should remain exploratory rather than control the primary rendering.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Covering what is near produces distant schism.** **ع ن د B004** gives proximity and presence, **ك ف ر B001/B003** covering and rejection, **ش ق ق B004** group-splitting conflict, and **ب ع د B001/B003** remoteness and created separation. The hypothetical begins with origin at divine presence and ends with the rejecter inside distance. I infer that distance is the result of covering, not a property of the source.
2. **Error is a sideward course that keeps splitting.** **ض ل ل B001** gives departure from guidance, while **ش ق ق B001/B009** gives splitting and sideward departure from straightness. The superlative “more astray” is located *in* schism. I infer a recursive mechanism: each sideward move opens a further split from the direct course. The ayah reads as self-deepening divergence.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 41:53 immediately counters distance with signs in outer horizons and inner selves until truth becomes clear. 41:54 then reveals that even doubt and attempted separation remain inside complete enclosure.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **The hypothetical exposes disbelief as a chosen far side.** Lexically, `ر ء ي B013` is the “tell me” alerting formula, `ك ف ر B003` rejection of truth, `ض ل ل B001` departure from guidance and aim, `ش ق ق B004` group-splitting conflict, `ش ق ق B009` sideward departure from straightness, and `ب ع د B001` remoteness. Structurally, the conditional asks the rejecters to inspect the case in which the discourse is from God; 41:51 has just embodied side-turning, and 41:53 will pair horizons with selves until truth becomes clear. I assign `شقاق` the role of occupying an opposed side and distance the role of the separation that opposition compounds. The inferred arrow is that rejection after the hypothesis is not neutral suspension but movement farther along a split course. The ayah reads error as positional escalation.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 41:53 answered the far split with signs at both the world’s edges and within the self. 41:54 completed the correction by replacing imagined remoteness with all-encompassing presence.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi düşünce bilimi bağlamında sözün bir şeyin tanımı veya sınır bildirimi için kullanıldığını açıklar. Bu, normal konuşma değil, teknik tanım işleviyle sınırlı bir kalıptır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal teknik tanım kullanımıdır; sıradan sözlü ifade anlamı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam collocation olduğu için tanım, teknik tanım bildiren özel kalıplara bağlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Düşünce bilimi bağlamında bir şeyin ne olduğunu belirleyen tanım veya sınır bildirimi için söz kelimesinin kullanılmasıdır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, sözün bir şeyin tanımı veya sınırı olarak kullanılmasıdır.
Kullanım teknik düşünce bilimi bağlamıyla sınırlıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt bu özel dalı tek bir aktarım üzerinden verir; ortaklaştırılacak ayrı bir çok kaynaklı iddia yoktur.

error_profile.preserves: Tanım bildirme işlevini korur.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه استعمال المنطقيين القول بمعنى الحد، كقول الجوهر وقول العرض أي حدهما.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه القول المنطوق العادي إلا إذا أريد به الحد.
branches.source_phrase_ar: يستعمله المنطقيون في معنى الحد فيقولون قول الجوهر كذا وقول العرض كذا أي حدهما (mufradat)

source_note.MU: Tekil aktarım, teknik bağlamda sözün bir şeyin tanımı anlamında kullanılmasını verir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sesli bir hitap gelmeden anlamın kişinin içine doğmasını ve bunun söz diye adlandırılmasını anlatır. Çerçeve, işitilen konuşmadan ayrılan içe doğan anlam aktarımını doğru yakalar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal içe doğan anlam aktarımıdır; işitilen sözlü hitap değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam non_bare olduğu için tanım özel içe doğma bağlamıyla sınırlıdır.

concept_map.definition: İşitilen bir hitap olmadan, bir anlamın kişinin içine doğması ve bunun söz diye adlandırılmasıdır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, sözsüz biçimde içe doğan anlam aktarımıdır.
Bu kullanım işitilen hitabı özellikle dışarıda bırakır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt bu özel dalı tek bir aktarım üzerinden verir; ortaklaştırılacak ayrı bir çok kaynaklı iddia yoktur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda anlam kişiye gelmiş sayılır; komşu dalda kişinin içinde tuttuğu ve henüz dışa vurmadığı söz vardır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Aday komşular iletim, çağrı, ses, beden eğilmesi ve kökün iç söz dalları açısından tarandı; sessiz iç anlam sınırı yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه القول في الإلهام، حيث يسمى إلقاء المعنى قولا من غير خطاب وارد.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الخطاب اللفظي المسموع.
branches.source_phrase_ar: في الإلهام فإن ذلك لم يكن بخطاب ورد عليه بل كان ذلك إلهاما فسماه قولا (mufradat)

source_note.MU: Tekil aktarım, işitilen hitap olmaksızın içe doğan anlamın söz diye adlandırılmasını verir.

root_profile.summary: Bu kök, sesle söze dökme çekirdeğinden konuşma organı, konuşkan kişi, eski unvan, yalan isnat, söylenti, müzakere, hüküm dayatma, iç söz, görüş benimseme, sözsüz belirtme, içten önemseme, teknik tanım ve içe doğan anlam gibi ayrı dallara yayılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi azlığı çokluğun karşıtı olarak verir; ayrıca yoksulluk, düşüklük, bir şeyi az görme ve belirli yapılarda yokluğa ya da seyrekliğe yaklaşan kullanımları açıkça destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol yalnızca sayı ve miktar azlığını ve buna bağlı kullanımları kapsar; yükseklik, kap, taşıma ve titreme anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Temel azlık anlamı ile yoksullaşma ve az görme gibi türemiş biçimler birlikte bulunur; yokluk ve seyrekleşme anlamları ise yalnızca belirtilen yapılara bağlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin sayı, miktar ya da ölçü bakımından çok olmayışını bildirir. Bundan yoksulluk ve düşüklük, bir şeyi az sayma veya az gösterme ve belirli yapılarda hiçlik ya da seyrek gerçekleşme anlamları gelişir.

facets.statement: Bir varlığın sayı, miktar veya ölçü bakımından çok olmayışıdır.
Azlık, kişinin yoksullaşması veya toplum içinde düşük ve değersiz görülmesi sonucuna uzanabilir.
Bir şeyi gerçekte ya da değerlendiren kişinin gözünde az sayma ve az gösterme anlamını taşır.
Belirli olumsuzluk ve sıklık yapılarında hiç yokluğu veya bir eylemin pek seyrek gerçekleşmesini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar azlığın temel sayı ve miktar karşıtlığında birleşir; yoksulluk ve düşüklük, az sayma ve bazı yapılarda yokluğa yaklaşan kullanım bu çekirdeğin düzenli uzantılarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sayı, miktar veya ölçünün çok olmayışını bildiren temel anlam için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Çokluğun karşıtı olan sayı ve miktar azlığını doğrudan korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin sayı veya miktar bakımından çok olmadığının söylendiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Temel azlık durumunu doğal bir Türkçe yapıyla tam olarak verir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Azlığın kişide yoksulluk ve toplumsal düşüklük sonucu doğurduğu bağlamlara özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Yoksulluk ile düşüklük arasındaki kaynakta kurulan uzantıyı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir miktarın veya verilen bir şeyin yetersiz ya da küçük sayıldığı değerlendirme bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Değerlendiren kişinin bir şeyi az sayması anlamını tam olarak korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnızca sıklığı çok düşüren veya olumsuzluğu pekiştiren kalıplaşmış yapılarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kalıba bağlı seyrekleşme ve yokluğa yaklaşma değerlerini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol genel azlığı özellikle mal, yiyecek ve verili miktar örnekleri çevresinde toplar.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Temel azlık alanları büyük ölçüde örtüşür; ancak bu kolun değerlendirme, toplumsal sonuç ve kalıba bağlı olumsuzluk uzantıları komşu kartta aynı sınırla kurulmaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kolun çekirdeği sayı ve miktar azlığıdır; değersizlik bunun ikincil bir sonucudur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kolun çekirdeği güçsüzlük, aşağılık ve düşünme yetisindeki zayıflıktır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da azlıkla değersizlik veya düşüklük arasında anlam ilişkisi kurabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kolda değersizlik azlığın uzantısıdır; komşu kolda ise zayıflık ve aşağılık bağımsız çekirdektir, bu yüzden olağan kullanımda birbirlerinin yerine geçmezler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol bir şeyin sayıca veya miktarca az oluşunu bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol bir şeyin başını, tepesini veya en üst bölümünü bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Aynı kökün sesçe yakın iki ayrı anlam kolu olmaları dışında ortak çekirdekleri yoktur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Ses benzerliği anlam birliği doğurmaz: biri çokluğun karşıtı olan azlığı, diğeri uzamsal olarak en üstte bulunan baş veya tepeyi adlandırır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı; genel azlıkla en yakın örtüşme, değersizlikle kurulan yan ilişki ve aynı kökteki tepe anlamıyla olası karışma en açıklayıcı üç sınır olarak seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: القليل والقِلَّة ضد الكثرة، ويدخل فيه الافتقار والذلة، وتقليل الشيء في العين، واستقلاله، واستعمال القليل للنفي أو للندرة
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس علو الشيء ولا الجرة ولا الحمل ولا الرعدة

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyin en üstünü veya başını çekirdek anlam olarak verir; dağın yuvarlak üst bölümü, insan başı ve kılıcın başındaki topuz bu çekirdeğin açık uzmanlaşmalarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol uzamsal başı ve en üst parçayı bildirir; sayısal azlık ya da büyük kap anlamını içermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel baş ve en üst bölüm anlamı ile dağ tepesi, insan başı ve kılıç topuzu gibi yapıya bağlı uzmanlaşmalar ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin başını veya en üst bölümünü bildirir. Dağın üstteki yuvarlak parçası, insan başı ve kılıcın sap ucundaki topuz bu uzamsal çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir nesnenin veya oluşumun başı ya da en üstte bulunan bölümüdür.
Dağın en üstünde yer alan, kimi tanımda yuvarlak biçimli bölümünü adlandırır.
İnsan başı ile kılıcın sap ucundaki başlık veya topuz da aynı üst ve baş kavramıyla adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar bir şeyin başı ve en üst bölümü üzerinde birleşir; dağ tepesi temel örnektir, insan başı ile kılıç topuzu da aynı biçimsel ve uzamsal çizgide yer alır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir nesnenin ya da doğal oluşumun en üst bölümünü ve başını kapsayan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Baş olma ile uzamsal olarak en üstte bulunma çekirdeğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dağın en üst ve kimi zaman yuvarlak bölümünün adlandırıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dağa özgü en üst bölüm uzmanlaşmasını doğrudan korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsan başının veya başka bir şeyin baş sayılan üst bölümünün kastedildiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Üst bölümün baş olarak kavranmasını kısa ve doğal biçimde verir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kılıcın sap ucunda bulunan başlık ya da topuz parçası anlatılırken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kılıca özgü baş veya üst parça uzmanlaşmasını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol başı, tepeyi ve en üstte bulunan parçayı bildirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi büyük bir küp veya iri kap anlamında birleşir; iki kaplık ölçü ve belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler de aynı kap anlamını somutlaştırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol büyük bir kap türünü ve onun ölçü değerini kapsar; nicelik azlığı veya dağ tepesi anlamını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Büyük küp anlamı çekirdektir; belirli bir bölgeye bağlanan kap adı ile iki kaplık ölçü yalnızca kendi yapılardaki uzmanlaşmalardır.

concept_map.definition: Büyük bir küpü veya küpe benzeyen iri kabı bildirir. Belirli bir bölgenin iri küpleri ve iki böyle kabın aldığı miktar bu kap anlamına bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Küpe benzeyen, özellikle sıvı taşımaya veya saklamaya elverişli büyük bir kaptır.
Belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler veya büyük toprak kaplar bu adın tanınmış bir türünü oluşturur.
İki büyük kap, bu iki kabın kendisini veya onların aldığı sıvı miktarını bildiren bir ölçü değeri kazanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar iri bir küp veya büyük kap üzerinde birleşir; tanınmış bölgesel kaplar büyüklüğü örnekler, iki kaplık kullanım ise nesne adını kapasite ölçüsüne taşır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Küpe benzeyen iri kabı adlandıran temel ve en doğal Türkçe karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Kabın küp türünde ve olağandan büyük oluşunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kabın özellikle su alması ve büyük kapasitesi öne çıkarıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Büyük kabı ve kaynakta belirtilen su taşıma kapasitesini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol iri küpün yanı sıra küpün yerleştirildiği tahta destekleri de kapsayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da çok büyük bir küpü veya fıçımsı saklama kabını adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Kap nesnesinde güçlü bir örtüşme vardır; bu kol ölçü değerine uzanırken komşu kol kabın yerleştirildiği desteği de kapsayan farklı bir sınır kurar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol kabın özellikle iri oluşunu ve iki kaplık ölçü değerini belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol genel bir küp veya saklama kabını büyüklük koşulu olmadan adlandırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da küp biçimindeki büyükçe saklama kapları için kullanılabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kolda büyük kapasite kurucu bir özelliktir; komşu kartta kap türü öndedir ve aynı ölçü uzantısı bulunmaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol büyük bir küpü ve ona dayalı kapasite ölçüsünü bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol bir şeyin başını, tepesini veya en üst bölümünü bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Aynı kökün sesçe yakın iki ayrı anlam kolu olmaları dışında ortak çekirdekleri yoktur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Biri hacimli bir kap ve onun ölçüsüdür; diğeri bir varlığın uzamsal olarak en üstteki parçasıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; büyük küp anlamına en yakın iki kap komşusu ile aynı kökteki tepe anlamından ayrım, sınırı göstermek için yeterli ve yinelenmeyen karşılaştırmalardır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: القلة التي جاءت في الحديث مثل قلال هجر هي جرار عظام (jamhara)؛ القلة إناء للعرب كالجرة الكبيرة؛ قلال هجر شبيهة بالحباب (sihah)؛ قلتين يعني هذه الحباب العظام واحدتها قلة؛ قلال هجر؛ القلة منها تأخذ مزادة من الماء (tahdhib)؛ القلة ما أقله الإنسان من جرة وحب (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yükü taşıma veya taşıyabilme ile öznenin yükselip harekete geçmesini aynı kolda açıkça toplar; kuşun uçuşa kalkması, göğün yükselmesi ve yolcuların yüklenip ayrılması ayrı katılımcı gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Taşıma, yükselme ve yüklenerek yola koyulma bu kolun sınırıdır; salt sayısal azlık bu anlamlara katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yük taşıma ile yükselme çekirdek çizgileri ayrılır; ağır bulut taşıma, uçuşa kalkma ve yolcuların ayrılması yalnızca kendi özne ve yapılarında geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir yükü kaldırıp taşıyabilmeyi veya üstlenmeyi ve bir öznenin yükselerek harekete geçmesini bildirir. İkinci çizgi kuşun uçuşa kalkmasını, göğün yükselmesini ve yolcuların yüklenip yola koyulmasını kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi kaldıracak gücü bulmak, onu taşımak veya yük olarak üstlenmektir.
Bir öznenin aşağıdaki konumundan yükselmesi veya kuş gibi harekete ve uçuşa başlamasıdır.
Yolcuların yüklerini alıp bulundukları yerden ayrılarak yolculuğa başlamasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar bir yükü kaldırıp taşıma ile yukarı kalkarak harekete geçme çizgilerini bir araya getirir; kuş, gök, bulut ve yolcu örnekleri katılımcıya göre bu iki çizgiyi somutlaştırır.

concept_gloss.text: yük kaldırma, yükselme ve yola koyulma
concept_gloss.applicability: Taşıma, yukarı kalkma ve yüklenerek hareket etme çizgilerinin birlikte özetlenmesi gereken kavram haritasında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yük üstlenme, yükselme ve yolculuk için harekete geçme bileşenlerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin veya başka bir taşıyıcının bir nesnenin ağırlığını üstlenmesi bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yükü kaldırma gücü ile onu fiilen taşıma anlamlarını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Göğün yükselmesi veya kuşun uçuşa kalkması gibi yukarı yönlü hareket bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yukarı kalkma ile uçuş için yerden ayrılma değerlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir topluluğun yolculuk yüklerini alarak bulunduğu yerden ayrılması bağlamına özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Yük alma, ayrılma ve yolculuğa başlama aşamalarını birlikte korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol yükü taşımanın yanında yükselme, havalanma ve yüklenerek ayrılma anlamlarını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol yükü taşıma eyleminden çok onu taşıyacak güce sahip olmayı öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da bir yükün ağırlığını karşılayacak gücü ve taşıma yeterliğini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Taşıma yeterliği ortak olsa da bu kol fiilî taşıma ve yerden yükselme yönlerine açılır; komşu kol güç yetirme sınırında kalır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol yük üstlenmeyi, kuşun havalanmasını ve yolcuların yüklenerek ayrılmasını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol kişinin oturduğu yerden kalkmasını ve bir nesneyi bulunduğu yerden kaldırmayı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da aşağıdaki veya durağan bir konumdan kalkma ve hareket başlangıcını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol yükselmeyi taşıma ve yolculukla bağlar; komşu kol bedensel olarak ayağa kalkma ve nesneyi yerinden kaldırma çevresindedir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kolda yolculuk anlamı yolcuların yüklerini alıp bulundukları yerden ayrılmasıyla sınırlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol yol üzerinde ilerlemeyi ve belirli bir hedefe doğru seyahat etmeyi genel olarak bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da bir yerden ayrılarak yolculuğa başlama durumunda buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol başlangıçtaki yüklenme ve kalkış anını anlatır; komşu kol yolculuğun kendisini ve hedefe doğru ilerlemeyi çekirdek edinir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı; taşıma gücü, yerden kalkma ve yolculuğa başlama komşuları bu kolun üç kurucu yönünü en az yinelemeyle açıklar.
branches.what_is_ar: حمل الشيء واحتماله، وارتفاعه أو نهوضه، وارتحال القوم ظاعنين
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس مجرد القلة العددية، ولا قلة الجبل، ولا الرعدة
branches.source_phrase_ar: أقل الجرة أطاق حملها؛ استقلت السماء ارتفعت؛ استقل القوم مضوا وارتحلوا (sihah)؛ أقل الرجل الشيء واستقله إذا احتمله؛ استقل الطائر إذا نهض للطيران؛ استقل النبات أناف؛ استقل القوم إذا احتملوا ظاعنين؛ أقلت سحابا ثقالا أي حملت؛ قل إذا رفع وقل إذا علا (tahdhib)؛ أقلت سحابا ثقالا أي احتملته؛ أقللت كذا وجدته قليل المحمل (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kişiyi korku veya öfke yüzünden tutan titreme ve silkinişi açıkça tanımlar; genel hareket kararsızlığı değil, duygusal tetikleyicisi bulunan bedensel bir sarsıntı söz konusudur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol insanda korku veya öfkeyle beliren titremeyle sınırlıdır; nesnelerin genel sallanma ve yerinde duramama hali ayrı koldadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Duygudan doğan titreme temel addır; kişiyi titremenin tutması ve öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi yalnızca ilgili yapılara bağlı anlatımlardır.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın korku veya öfke yüzünden titremesi, ürpermesi ya da bedensel olarak silkelenmesidir. Durum, kişiyi bir titreme nöbetinin tutması veya öfkenin titremeyle dışa vurulması biçiminde anlatılabilir.

facets.statement: İnsan bedeninde beliren titreme, ürperti veya istemsiz silkiniş halidir.
Titremenin belirleyici nedeni korku ya da öfkedir.
Belirli yapılarda titremenin kişiyi tutması veya kişinin öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar insandaki titreme ve silkinişte birleşir; korku ile öfke başlıca nedenlerdir ve durum hem kişiyi tutan bir nöbet hem öfkenin bedensel belirtisi olarak anlatılır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Duygusal nedeni ve bedensel titremeyi birlikte taşıyan bütün kol için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Korku veya öfke koşulunu ve bunun doğurduğu bedensel titremeyi birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Korkunun yol açtığı kısa ve istemsiz bedensel titreme bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Korkuya bağlı istemsiz titreme ve silkiniş hissini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Titremenin kişiyi birden tutan belirgin bir durum olarak anlatıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Titremenin kişiyi tutan bedensel bir olay olarak sunuluşunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Öfkenin bedensel titreme halinde dışa vurulduğu kişi bağlamlarına özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Öfke nedenini ve onunla birlikte ortaya çıkan titremeyi korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol titremenin korku veya öfkeden doğmasını anlam sınırının parçası yapar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol insandaki titreme veya silkinişi belirli bir duygusal nedenle sınırlamaz.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da insan bedeninde ortaya çıkan titreme veya silkinişi adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bedensel olay aynıdır; bu kol korku ve öfke koşulunu taşırken komşu kart neden bakımından daha genel kalır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol korkunun yanında öfkeyi de titremenin belirleyici nedeni olarak içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol hastalık, gevşeklik, yumuşaklık ve korkaklıkla ilişkili titremeleri de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da özellikle korku sırasında insanda görülen titreme ve ürpermede örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Korkuya bağlı kullanımda yakınlaşırlar; bu kol öfkeyi ekler, komşu kol ise hastalık ve bedensel gevşeklik gibi başka nedenlere açılır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; genel insan titremesi ve nedenleri daha geniş ürperme alanı, bu kolun kişi ve duygu sınırını en iyi gösterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi hareket ettirip sallandırma, nesnenin bulunduğu yerde kararlı duramaması ve hareketin çıkardığı sesi birlikte verir; bunlar tek bir fiziksel hareket olayının neden, sonuç ve işitsel yönleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol genel fiziksel oynama, kararsızlık ve hareket sesiyle ilgilidir; korku veya öfkeden doğan insana özgü titreme değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak kolun hareket ettirme, sallanma, yerinde duramama ve hareket sesi anlamlarını kapsar; özel bir yapının anlamı genelleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi hareket ettirerek yerinden oynatmayı ve onun kararsızca sallanıp bulunduğu yerde duramamasını bildirir; bu hareketin çıkardığı ses de aynı olayın işitsel yönüdür.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi hareket ettirip onun yerinden oynamasına ve sarsılmasına neden olmaktır.
Nesnenin bulunduğu yerde sabit kalmayıp sallanması, oynaması veya düzensiz hareket etmesidir.
Sallanma ve yer değiştirme sırasında çıkan ses, hareket olayının işitsel belirtisi olarak adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar dışarıdan hareket ettirme ile nesnenin kararsızca sallanıp yerinde duramaması üzerinde birleşir; hareketin sesi bu fiziksel olayın ayrılmaz işitsel belirtisi olarak eklenir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Neden olunan hareketi ve nesnenin ortaya çıkan kararsız sallanmasını birlikte kapsayan temel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Hareket ettirme nedenini ve sabit kalamayan nesnenin sallanma sonucunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin bir nesneyi hareket ettirerek onun oynamasına ve sarsılmasına neden olduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dışarıdan uygulanan hareketi ve nesnenin sarsılması sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nesnenin gevşeklik veya kararsızlık nedeniyle bulunduğu yerde sabit kalmadığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sabit kalamama ile düzensiz sallanma durumunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sallanan veya oynayan nesnenin çıkardığı sesin adlandırıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sesin genel bir ses değil, hareketten doğan işitsel belirti oluşunu korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, görmeyi hem gözle algılama hem de gözün işlevine benzetilen içsel kavrayış olarak kuruyor. Doğrudan göz tanıklığı bu çekirdeğin duyusal gerçekleşimidir; zihinsel görüş, uyku düşü ve başkalarına görünme amacı bu dalın dışında kalır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın çekirdeği görsel ya da içsel algıdır; belirli söz öbekleri ve bakma çabası ayrı kullanımlar olarak tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın görme çekirdeği ile doğrudan göz tanıklığını ve görmeye çalışma bildiren bağlı kullanımlar birbirine karıştırılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi gözle ya da göz işlevi gören içsel kavrayışla algılamaktır. Gözün eriştiği yerde doğrudan görme, bu anlamın duyusal ve tanıklığa dayalı gerçekleşimidir.

facets.statement: Görülebilir bir şeyi gözle veya benzer bir içsel kavrayışla algılama.
Bir şeyi gözün eriştiği yerde doğrudan ve tanık olarak görme.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, gözle görmeyi temel alır ve bazı anlatımlarda bu algıyı içsel kavrayışa kadar genişletir; doğrudan göz tanıklığı özellikle belirtilir.

concept_gloss.text: gözle ya da içsel kavrayışla görme

error_profile.loses: İçsel kavrayışla görme olanağını dışarıda bırakır.
